title: RuleDraftRequest
description: The input of rule.draft: the rule's address, the text of its new version, and the person's reason, which the log keeps (step 28's README, decisions D7 and D11). This tutorial's own schema: the specification names no operation that drafts a control. The address is dsor://org_456/rule/high-value-payment; its /rule/ part is this tutorial's. The text is a control as control.schema.json shapes it, without the six fields DSoR sets itself: id, version, status, compiled_by, reviewed_by, and effective_from. Line ⑨ checks the rest against control.schema.json.

reason.description: Why the version is drafted, in the person's own words, for the people who read the log.
